explanation: Any website can read responses with the user's cookies. Fix: stop sending the wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.
The admin page answers without authentication. Fix: return 403 until a real login is in front of it.
Another site can put this page in a hidden frame and trick clicks. Fix: send X-Frame-Options DENY and a frame-ancestors policy.
The X-Powered-By header tells attackers which framework runs here. Fix: remove the header.
The session cookie can be read by scripts or sent cross-site. Fix: set HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict and a Max-Age.
